quotations.projectDescription: Single Storey Rear Extension creating an enlarged Kitchen and a new Dining Room, Internal Alterations to the existing Lounge and Dining Room, and refurbishment of the First Floor Bathroom and En-Suite.

lineItems.itemDescription:
-> A free, no obligation on-site design consultation meeting.
-> Includes discussion of the brief, the proposed extension footprint, and the available planning routes.

-> Full measured building survey of BOTH the Ground Floor and First Floor.
-> Both floors are required because the internal wall removals will need new beams, and the Structural Engineer must establish what bears onto the walls being altered.
-> Includes travel to and from site.

lineItems.description: Laser Scan Registration & Drone Image Processing
lineItems.itemDescription:
-> Processing of the laser scan data and drone image set already captured on site.
-> Scan registration and photogrammetry alignment to produce an accurate base for the existing conditions model.

-> Full three dimensional model of the existing property, both floors.
-> Forms the base model for all subsequent design work and for the TrueVision experience.

-> Development of the rear extension design, including the relationship to the existing Bay Window and the retained half of the building.
-> Massing, roof form and rear elevation glazing studies.

lineItems.description: Internal Layout Development : Kitchen, Dining & Living
lineItems.itemDescription:
-> Development of the enlarged Kitchen layout, retaining the hob and cooker on the existing wall as requested.
-> Island layout and circulation testing to maximise food preparation space and provide breakfast seating.
-> Testing of the internal glazed sliding door position between the Lounge and existing Dining Room.
-> Assessment of whether a casual seating and television area can be accommodated within the extension.

-> Preparation and issue of the interactive 3D TrueVision model, allowing the proposals to be walked through online.
-> Distribution via the Noble Architecture Project Portal.

-> Coordination with the Client and with the appointed Contractor.
-> Project administration for the Concept Design stage.
